name: Radio / Model Quality
description: Model Quality product scenario for the Radio component.

controls.name: options
controls.description: Visible options in navigation order. Empty or missing options render an empty group.

controls.name: value
controls.description: Controlled selection; null means no selection. Parent updates do not emit a change.

controls.name: defaultValue
controls.description: Uncontrolled initial selection, restored by form reset.

controls.name: orientation
controls.description: Visual arrangement and ARIA orientation. Both arrow pairs remain available.

controls.name: autoFocus
controls.description: Focus the selected enabled option, or the first enabled option, on mount.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Accessible group name when there is no external visible heading.

controls.name: aria-labelledby
controls.description: Ids of visible headings that name this group.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disable every option; native inputs leave focus navigation and form submission.

controls.name: form
controls.description: Id of an external native form that owns all options.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Shared outer spacing around each option; preserves native controls when toggled.

controls.name: name
controls.description: Nonempty native group and FormData key; use a distinct name for each independent group in a form.

controls.name: required
controls.description: Require a selection before submission. Native group validation requires a nonempty name.
